item.title: DL Gabriel Truss survived severe car accident to earn second chance at college football
item.description: Garden City Community College defensive lineman Gabriel Truss committed to Eastern Michigan this weekend. The Eagles have a good class of JUCO additions coming in, but Truss is a little different. He is a 6-foot-3, 320-pound run stuffer who has college experience having played at Missouri Western State prior to coming to Garden City. What makes him extra unique are the circumstances that brought him to Garden City and have made him so appreciative of every day he gets to play football and simply be alive. “I got in a car accident and thought I’d never play football again,” Truss said. “I had split my jaw almost in half, I was missing my bottom four teeth, I fractured the top of my spine, broke my leg, fractured rib, I had a concussion, and had emergency jaw surgery.” The early days in the hospital were tough. “There were days when I was in terrible pain,” Truss said. “I’d be in my hospital bed, pressing my button and waiting for the nurse to come bring me pills to take away the pain and I tried not to question why God put me through this. But my faith played a big factor. I’m so thankful now for getting offers to play at the next level.” Eastern Michigan proved to be that right opportunity, with his official visit to Ypsilanti sealing the deal for Truss. “I would say the coaches, their hospitality, and their interest in me made me want to be there. And I liked the facilities, the meeting rooms and all that,” Truss said. With that, Truss now prepares for the next step of his journey, which is enrolling mid-year at Eastern Michigan. “Getting this opportunity, coming from where I’m from and being through what I’ve been through, I just am very thankful,” Truss said. Truss had 16 tackles (2.5 for loss) this season for Garden City.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo Ruled Out for Heat’s Showdown Against Thunder
item.description: Credit: Cary Edmondson-Imagn Images The Miami Heat will be missing a crucial piece of their lineup as they prepare to face the Oklahoma City Thunder on Sunday. Star forward Giannis Antetokounmpo has been ruled out due to a groin injury, marking his first missed game since joining the Heat in the offseason. Antetokounmpo, a former two-time MVP, has been instrumental in Miami’s early success this season, averaging an impressive 28.2 points, 12.6 rebounds, 5.5 assists, and 1.3 blocks while shooting 60.2% from the field across 15 games. His absence will undoubtedly be felt as the Heat look to maintain their momentum. The Thunder, too, will be without star power, as reigning two-time MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is sidelined with a lower back contusion and neck strain. Both players were initially listed as questionable, but the decision to keep them out comes as both teams navigate through the challenges of the season. Miami is speculated to look to Bobby Portis Jr. to step into the starting lineup in place of Antetokounmpo. Portis brings energy and experience, but replacing the production and leadership of Giannis will be a tall order for the Heat. As the Heat entered Sunday with a record of 9-6, sitting in sixth place in the Eastern Conference, the team is keen to capitalize on their home court advantage. The Thunder, meanwhile, are dealing with a slew of injuries to key players, including Alex Caruso, Jaylin Williams, and Chet Holmgren, which has tested their depth. While both Antetokounmpo and Gilgeous-Alexander are playing at an All-NBA level this season, the Heat will need to rally together in Giannis’s absence. With the stakes high, Miami aims to secure a victory and keep pace in the competitive East. Fans will be eagerly watching to see how the Heat adapt and who steps up in this pivotal matchup.

item.title: We haven’t seen the last of the major tech outages

item.title: FEATURE | Five things we learned from Bundesliga Matchday 10
item.description: FEATURE | Five things we learned from Bundesliga Matchday 10 The Bundesliga returned following the final international break of the year, and what a spectacle it was. From a swing of the title race pendulum, to changes at the bottom of the table, Get German Football News has you covered with the latest talking points after Matchday 10. Here are five things we learned… Bayern Munich have an attacking problem This would seem like an obvious thing to say after Harry Kane was ruled out for the next three months with an ankle injury,, while Luis Diaz, Ismael Saibari and Serge Gnabry are also out injured, but this has been a problem for most of the season too, and these injuries are likely to make the matter worse. Even with Kane fit, Bayern have been wasteful in front of goal this season. Granted, some of the results the ball just wouldn’t go in, like against Schalke and Augsburg, but the difference between this season and last year was that Bayern would prove to be far more clinical in front of goal, but Germany’s record champions seemed to have lost that edge now, as shown in their 1-1 draw with Cologne on Friday night. This has resulted in games where Bayern should win comfortably being a lot more difficult, mainly due to their own doing. With the injury to Kane, and with no fit back-up, this problem is likely to get worse and could make or break Bayern’s Bundesliga season. It’s now up to Vincent Kompany and his coaching team to find a solution, and quick. Borussia Dortmund show some bottle Usually after Bayern drop points, Dortmund fail to capitalise, and ultimately, nothing would change. However, Matchday 10 was different. Naturally, Dortmund did not make it easy for themselves against last-placed Borussia Mönchengladbach as they struggled to break down Alexander Blessin’s side, while Felix Nmecha’s winner in the 80th minute came from a mistake by Gladbach keeper Daniel Batz. But a win is a win, and Dortmund are now top of the Bundesliga with a two-point lead over Bayern. Considering how this has been a problem for Dortmund before, it goes to show the effect that Niko Kovač is having on the side, that they are able to win these types of games – and to win ugly, especially when they have previously struggled in the past. Their latest 1-0 victory is already the third of its kind this season. We probably now have a title race on our hands. Brajan Gruda is one of the signings of the season While the move is still technically a loan, it is more than likely that RB Leipzig will make the signing of Brajan Gruda permanent , and they will have to do their best not to immediately flip him for what will be a healthy profit. Since returning to Leipzig in the summer, Gruda has been one of Leipzig’s standout players, like Antonio Nusa and Christopher Nkunku. The 22-year-old only made his Germany debut in the recent international break, but he immediately hit the ground running under Jürgen Klopp – where he recorded two goals and provided two assists against Se

item.title: Ravens’ Derrick Henry suffers possible concussion on TD vs. Panthers
item.description: Credit: James Lang-Imagn Images Ravens’ Derrick Henry suffers possible concussion on TD vs. Panthers appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . On Sunday, the Baltimore Ravens continued their losing streak with a brutal road loss at the hands of the Carolina Panthers in narrow fashion. The Ravens took the field in this one without several key players, including star quarterback Lamar Jackson, and their injury situation went from bad to worse during the game. “#Ravens RB Derrick Henry is being evaluated for a concussion after landing hard in the end zone following a TD,” reported NFL insider Ian Rapoport of the NFL Network on X, formerly Twitter. Henry had a big day for Baltimore in this one, scoring a touchdown and rushing for 94 yards, and it remains to be seen what the result of the concussion evaluation was, as there was no update on the star running back after the game from head coach Jesse Minter, per Ravens insider Jamison Hensley on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The last thing Baltimore needs at this point is another injury to one of its key players, as the team has already seen both Jackson and backup Tyler Huntley go down with various injuries, prompting the Ravens to trade for veteran Jacoby Brissett two weeks ago with the Arizona Cardinals, although that wasn’t enough to get the team a win vs the Los Angeles Chargers last week. The team will certainly be hoping for good news on the Henry front in the coming days. In any case, the Ravens are next slated to hit the field next Sunday for a tough road game vs the Houston Texans at 1:00 pm ET. item.title: Studs and duds from Bears' 21-13 win against the Saints
item.description: The Chicago Bears have now won five straight games after taking down the New Orleans Saints, 21-13, in Week 11. They still had two turnovers in this game, although they also forced two takeaways and scored 13 points off of them. Jeffery Simmons had one of the best games of his career, while Montez Sweat also had the Bears ’ first safety in nearly five years. Offensively, things stalled after the second quarter. Still, quarterback Caleb Williams finished the game with two touchdowns and completed over 65 percent of his passes. Chicago also got Salvon Ahmed involved in the running game and he finished with 33 rushing yards on just six carries. Here are mostly studs and a few duds from the Bears’ win against the Saints, including All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, who tied his career-high in sacks in this game with three, and cornerback Jaylon Johnson, who once again struggled in coverage. Stud: DT Jeffery Simmons What a game for Jeffery Simmons. Throughout his career, he has always played well when facing New Orleans, but this was one of the best games of his entire career. Simmons tied his career-high in sacks with three. His only other game with three sacks was back in 2021. He now has five sacks in three games since joining the Bears. This trade has immediately paid off for Chicago and turned them into a championship-caliber defense. Dud: CB Jaylon Johnson After having a pick-six in Chicago’s last game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, Jaylon Johnson returned to his regular-season form in this game. It felt like every time there was a blown coverage in this game, mostly against Chris Olave, Johnson was the one in coverage. The Bears’ weakness on defense is certainly their secondary and Johnson is a major reason why, since he is severely underperforming. Stud: WR Zavion Thomas This may have been the NFL’s introduction to Chicago’s rookie wide receiver, Zavion Thomas. His speed was on full display with his 30-yard run to set up the Bears’ second touchdown of the game and his impressive 40-yard catch on third-and-17 to set up Chicago’s field goal in the third quarter. However, his diving catch on a broken third-down play in the fourth quarter may have been his best play of the day, even though the Bears did not end up scoring on that drive. New Orleans’ secondary slowed down most of Chicago’s playmakers, but they could not stop Zavion Thomas. Dud: RB D’Andre Swift New Orleans clearly emphasized stopping the Bears from running the ball. They held D’Andre Swift to just 51 yards and an average of 3.9 yards per carry. Kyle Monangai is not fully healthy, so the fact that he only had 18 rushing yards is not surprising. Still, I expected more out of Swift, who is supposed to be the leader of Chicago’s run game. Also, he now has three fumbles this season, which ties his career high. Their offense was mostly stifled because they were not able to get the run game going despite having 33 rushing attempts. Furthermore, Swift was barely involved in the p

item.title: Chiefs vs. Bills odds: Kansas City opens as 2.5-point underdogs on Thanksgiving
item.description: (Photo by Kevin Sabitus/Getty Images) The Kansas City Chiefs (8-2) will face one of their toughest tests of the season when they travel to Buffalo for a Thanksgiving night matchup against the Bills on Thursday. Kansas City extended its winning streak to three games with a convincing 34-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals at Arrowhead Stadium. Patrick Mahomes threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns, including two scoring passes to Travis Kelce, while rookie running back Emmett Johnson added 105 rushing yards and a touchdown. According to FanDuel Sportsbook , Buffalo opened as a 2.5-point home favorite over Kansas City. The Bills’ opening moneyline was -154, compared to +130 for the Chiefs, with the game’s opening over/under set at 49.5 points. The matchup represents a significant step up in competition for Kansas City following consecutive victories over the Jets , Falcons and Cardinals. Buffalo enters the short week coming off a 26-9 victory over the Miami Dolphins , setting the stage for another highly anticipated meeting between Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen. The Chiefs and Bills have developed one of the AFC’s most compelling rivalries, with their recent matchups carrying significant postseason implications. For Kansas City, Thursday’s game presents an opportunity to extend its winning streak to four games while strengthening its position in the AFC playoff race. item.title: ‘Worse outcome’ – Mike Pettine’s defense was worse than Christian Parker’s, says former Dallas Cowboys star
item.description: Photo by Sam Hodde/Getty Images The Dallas Cowboys defeated the Tennessee Titans to move to 5-6… But what about their defense? Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys’ offense stole the show against the Titans, winning 51-30. Ahead of the game, all the talk was about the team’s defense, after they promoted Mike Pettine to call plays in place of defensive coordinator Christian Parker. The switch was a response to the 46-40 loss to the 49ers, in which the Cowboys gave up almost 600 yards. Speaking after the game, head coach Brian Schottenheimer said he was pleased with the way the defense played. He told his press conference: “Overall, I was very proud of the defensive unit, coaches, and everybody.” But his response did not please former Cowboys wide receiver Isaiah Stanback, who told the Cowboys’ postgame show that he felt the defense actually went backwards. He pointed to the fact the team gave up 30 points against a Titans team that is now 1-9 in the standings. Isaiah Stanback: Cowboys went backwards “I don’t wholly agree with him,” Stanback said, in response to Schottenheimer being proud of the Cowboys’ defense. He explained: “Last [week], he faced one of the more prominent offenses in the [offensive] play caller, and some of the most dangerous weapons in the NFL. He faced one of the better quarterbacks in the NFL, Brock Purdy. “Christian McCaffrey, one of the best running backs you have played in the game, as far as catching the ball, running the ball. “You got five sacks against [a] San Francisco 49ers outfit. You got five sacks against the Tennessee outfit that has Cam Ward, has Tony Pollard, Chimere Dike, that’s a big difference, right? “You gave up 46 last week. You gave up 30 to a Tennessee Titans team, that came in averaging 18 points per game. “So you can feel as if you performed better, but in reality, if I’m looking at it in totality, yes, you gave up more yards. Yes, you gave up bigger plays. All that stuff last week, but it was against a substantially better outfit. “So, to me, as I look at this, I think giving up 30 to this outfit is actually a worse outcome than even what you faced last [week], in my opinion.” The Cowboys’ defense will be tested next against the Philadelphia Eagles on Thanksgiving, who secured a surprise 19-16 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers. item.title: Houston Dynamo midfielder Héctor Herrera charged with DWI in Montgomery County
item.description: Héctor Herrera on the pitch during a Houston Dynamo match in July. (Maria Lysaker/Getty Images) Houston Dynamo midfielder Héctor Herrera was charged with driving while intoxicated Saturday in Montgomery County, according to the sheriff's office. Herrera, 36, whom the team signed to a one-year deal in January, has bonded out of the Montgomery County Jail, according to Miranda Hahs, director of public affairs for the sheriff's office. Herrera's name did not appear in county court records or the jail inmate roster Sunday afternoon. Hahs did not answer further questions about the player's bail. No further information about the incident was available. The arrest comes days before the Dynamo are scheduled to begin the playoffs Tuesday in San Jose, Calif. The Tijuana, Mexico native was the Dynamo's highest paid player in 2022 with a salary of over $5 million. He's making $525,000 this year, according to the Football Reference online database. In a statement to the Chronicle, team communications manager Jack Holmes said the club and Major League Soccer are aware of Herrera's arrest. "The Houston Dynamo are aware of an incident involving Héctor Herrera on Friday night. The Club and Major League Soccer are working to gather additional information.We will refrain from providing further comment until appropriate," the statement read. item.title: It’s a Deal! Skubal to the Mets!
item.description: Sep 25, 2026; San Francisco, California, USA; Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Tarik Skubal (29) pitches during the first inning against the San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park. Mandatory Credit: Stan Szeto-Imagn Images It’s Official! Tarik Skubal is a New York Met . The New York Mets have agreed to terms with two-time AL Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal on a nine-year, $450 million contract , according to multiple reports on Sunday. The deal, first reported by the New York Post’s Jon Heyman and confirmed in its terms by ESPN’s Jeff Passan, sets a new standard as the richest contract ever given to a pitcher in MLB history. The agreement includes a $45 million signing bonus, full no-trade protection, and no opt-out clauses. Roughly $30 million is deferred. The average annual value comes to $50 million, also a record for a pitcher and well clear of the previous high-water marks set by Max Scherzer and Justin Verlander. It eclipses Yoshinobu Yamamoto’s 12-year, $325 million pact with the Dodgers by $125 million in total value. Skubal, who turned 30 last week, becomes the centerpiece of a Mets rotation that already features promising right-hander Nolan McLean. He joins a lineup built around Juan Soto, Francisco Lindor, and Bo Bichette. For owner Steve Cohen and president of baseball operations David Stearns, the signing is the clearest statement yet that the club intends to rebound from a disappointing 2026 season and contend immediately in 2027. The left-hander’s path to free agency was eventful. After winning consecutive Cy Young Awards in 2024 and 2025 with the Detroit Tigers, he underwent a procedure in May 2026 to remove loose bodies from his left elbow. He returned in roughly six weeks and was later traded to the Los Angeles Dodgers ahead of the deadline. Across both clubs in 2026, he went 12-7 with a 2.72 ERA and 186 strikeouts in 158⅔ innings. Because he changed teams midseason, the Dodgers could not make him a qualifying offer, so the Mets incur no draft-pick penalty for the signing. Skubal’s free-agent process moved quickly. He held in-person meetings last week in California with the Mets, Dodgers, Blue Jays, and Padres. New York was widely viewed as the favorite after an early offer in the neighborhood of nine years and nearly $400 million. Agent Scott Boras had indicated a strong likelihood the left-hander would decide before the collective bargaining agreement expires on December 1. Over the past three seasons, Skubal has posted a 2.42 ERA, ranking among the game’s elite in strikeouts, innings, and Wins Above Replacement. He has also shown postseason pedigree, with a career 2.13 ERA in eight playoff starts. The Mets are betting that version of Skubal remains the one who takes the mound in Queens for the rest of the decade.

item.title: Eagles vs. Steelers: The good, the bad, and the ugly
item.description: PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - NOVEMBER 22: Joe Milton III #14 of the Philadelphia Eagles passes the ball against the Pittsburgh Steelers in the third quarter at Lincoln Financial Field on November 22, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The Eagles defeated the Steelers 19-16. (Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images) | Getty Images It looks like Nick Sirianni has his job for another week. It looks like the Eagles are heading towards a threepeat as NFC East champions, and another playoff run in 2026. Well, one of those statements may have a drop of truth to it after the Eagles snapped one streak and preserved another in a 19-16 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers on an overcast Sunday at Lincoln Financial Field. The Eagles snapped their seven-game losing streak, their longest since 2012, during Andy Reid’s last season. The Eagles also continued their streak at home against Pittsburgh, winning for the 12th-straight time over the Steelers, who have not won in Philadelphia since October 24, 1965, (20–14 at Franklin Field), 61 years and two stadiums ago. Maybe the addition of former Eagles’ coach T.J. Paganatti as a consultant had something to do with the Eagles’ offensive line looking the best it has this season. The defense was strong, holding the Steelers to 73 yards rushing, 43 yards below their season average of 116 yards a game, and sacking 42-year-old relic Aaron Rodgers five times for minus-45 yards. Joe Milton was competent, moving the Eagles, especially in clutch situations, completing 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards. Saquon Barkley made a brief appearance as Saquon Barkley rushing for a game-high 75 yards, the bulk of which came on a first quarter 38-yard touchdown run, while Jeremiah Trotter Jr. led the defense with a game-high 13 tackles, Marcus Epps had his best game this season with a season-high 8 tackles, and a bunch of guys who had received very little playing time making significant contributions like Byron Young’s two sacks, Jon Jones’ three defended passes, and Gabe Hall coming off the practice squad for a sack. The Eagles are 3-7. But are they suddenly cured of the slopfest they perpetrated over the first nine games—absolutely not. More proof is demanded. If the Eagles can somehow beat Dallas, in Dallas, on Thanksgiving, with the lowly tanking Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts following them, this nightmare of a season could have life, with the Eagles sitting at 6-7 in an NFC East Division up for grabs. Did Sunday’s victory resuscitate the Eagles or briefly camouflage a bad football team for one week and in the long run hurt its draft status? The answer may be four days from now in Dallas. The Eagles are no longer the proud owners of the NFL’s current longest losing streak, which has now been handed down I-95 to sinking Baltimore Ravens’ six-game skid after starting the season 4-1. For four days, everything will be right in Eaglesland. Sirianni is 6-0 after the bye week, Milton will no doubt stir comparisons by Eagles’ fans and

item.title: Broncos vs. Raiders: Live Fan Discussion
item.description: DENVER, COLORADO - NOVEMBER 22: A flyover is pictured during the National Anthem prior to a game between the Las Vegas Raiders and the Denver Broncos at Empower Field At Mile High on November 22, 2026 in Denver, Colorado. (Photo by Justin Edmonds/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Denver Broncos will be looking to move to 8-2 on the year with a home win over the Las Vegas Raiders today. It figures to be an emotional day in the stands as fans mourn the death of the legendary Tom Jackson today. We all know how Jackson loved to beat the Raiders as a player, so what a chance to send a win and a mile high salute his way this afternoon. Kickoff is set for 2:25 p.m. Mile High time on Sunday, November 22, 2026 at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada. You can watch on CBS affiliates. The game will be called by Andrew Catalon (play-by-play), Logan Ryan (analyst), and AJ Ross (sideline). You can also check local Broncos radio network affiliate stations . Join the conversation! Sign up for a user account and get: Fewer ads Create community posts Comment on articles, community posts Rec comments, community posts New, improved notifications system! Download the SB Nation app on iOS or Android . Broncos vs. Raiders score predictions These two teams are in completely different situations. Vegas is looking to see what they have in their top overall pick while the Broncos are eying the AFC’s top seed and a Super Bowl run. This is a game the Broncos should win by double-digits, but this team also tends to play up or down to their opponent that day. However, coming off a bye week, I think they will be ready to roll on Sunday and finally give us a comfortable margin of victory. Broncos 33, Raiders 20 . item.title: Chivas honoured the story of Antonio, a courageous Mexican
item.description: Chivas honoured the story of Antonio, a courageous Mexican A passion for sports, perseverance, and the desire to overcome any obstacle are some of the qualities that set Antonio Vázquez apart. The 17-year-old has turned every challenge into an opportunity to prove his abilities and achieve his goals. In recognition of his effort, hard work, and dedication, Club Deportivo Guadalajara invited him to enjoy an unforgettable experience at Estadio AKRON this Sunday, where he got to share his passion for the red and white up close. Originally from Mérida, Yucatán, Antonio was born with limb agenesis, a condition in which both his feet and his left hand are absent. When he was born, his parents were told he might never be able to walk. However, through tremendous effort, his family's support, and especially his grandmother's unconditional encouragement, he learned to do so and discovered one of his greatest passions in sports. He has played recreational soccer in local tournaments since he was 9, and for the past three years, he has represented Yucatán as a para-athlete in the 100 meters and shot put in the T42/F42 classifications. His dedication has already earned him gold medals in all his events at the state level, as well as standout performances at the CONADE National Paralympics. He has won four medals at this competition: a bronze in Oaxaca in 2024, a gold in the 100 meters in Aguascalientes in 2025, and two silvers—one in shot put in Aguascalientes in 2025 and another in the 100 meters at the 2026 edition held in Guadalajara, Jalisco. A red-and-white heart since 2017 Beyond his passion for sports, Antonio has a deep love for Guadalajara. His journey as a Chivas fan began during the Clausura 2017 Final, when he watched the Sacred Flock win the Liga MX title. From that moment on, he became a loyal supporter of the team, finding in the red and white a passion he shares with his girlfriend. His favorite players include Roberto Alvarado and Hugo Camberos , whom he particularly admires. Antonio has closely followed the young red-and-white player's career since his early days with Tapatío, and even remembers that the first match he saw him play was against Venados de Yucatán. From that game on, he recognized his talent and believed he would make it to the First Team. An unforgettable experience with the Red-and-White Nation! As part of the Mexicanos con Valor initiative, Club Deportivo Guadalajara prepared a very special experience for Antonio, who traveled from Mérida, Yucatán, to the Pearl of Jalisco thanks to the support of Volaris, the team's official sponsor. Upon his arrival, the young para-athlete received a warm welcome and had the opportunity to explore different parts of the club, with a tour of Estadio AKRON and a visit to the JOVEM Museum , where he learned more about the club's history and most memorable moments. He also received a team jersey from the new charrería edition, personalized with his name, as a special memento of his visit. But

item.title: No. 10 Iowa State falls at No. 4 Iowa
item.description: Iowa State’s Coby Merril wrestles Iowa’s Ben Kueter in a 285-pound match Nov. 22, 2026 during Cy-Hawk wrestling dual at Carver-Hawkeye Arena in Iowa City, Iowa. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co IOWA CITY — The Cyclones brought a halftime lead and a wave of momentum into Carver-Hawkeye Arena on Sunday. But when the No. 4 Hawkeyes needed a spark out of the break, their upper-middleweights delivered a decisive response. Behind a dramatic late takedown from Carter Schubert and back-to-back major decisions by Gabe Arnold and Angelo Ferrari, No. 4 Iowa stormed past No. 10 Iowa State 21-12 to reclaim the Dan Gable Traveling Trophy in the annual Iowa Corn Cy-Hawk Dual. The Hawkeyes jumped out to an early 7-0 dual advantage behind strong lower-weight performances. At 125 pounds, 16th-ranked Leo DeLuca opened the afternoon with a dominant 9-0 major decision over No. 29 Rin Sakamoto. Unranked Kale Peterson followed at 133 pounds, pulling off a 2-0 decision over No. 18 Garrett Grice using a second-period escape and a full third-period rideout. The 10th-ranked Cyclones answered with three straight victories from 141 to 157 pounds to take control before intermission. Fourth-ranked Evan Frost got Iowa State on the board at 141 with a 1-0 victory over No. 7 Nasir Bailey, controlling mat position after a second-period escape. His brother Jacob, followed at 149 with a 7-2 win over No. 6 Ryder Block, scoring two takedowns to avenge a loss from the 2022 high school state finals. No. 9 Paniro Johnson then scored a first-period takedown at 157 pounds to edge No. 18 Jordan Williams 4-3, giving Iowa State a 9-7 lead at the break. The dual swung back in Iowa’s favor immediately following intermission at 165 pounds. Locked in a tight battle with No. 17 Connor Euton, No. 9 ranked Carter Schubert executed a clutch takedown with less than 10 seconds remaining on the clock to snatch a 9-8 decision and put the Hawkeyes ahead 10-9. That late heroics opened the floodgates for Iowa’s middle lineup. At 174 pounds, fifth-ranked Gabe Arnold pushed a relentless pace against Tate Naaktgeboren to rack up a 17-6 major decision. Third-ranked freshman Angelo Ferrari kept the pressure on at 184 pounds, controlling Aiden Riggins in a 17-3 major decision that extended Iowa’s lead to 18-9 and put the dual out of reach. Iowa State chipped away at 197 pounds when No. 21 Brayden Thompson accumulated more than a minute of riding time to earn a 3-2 decision over No. 26 Harvey Ludington. However, top-ranked heavyweight Ben Kueter closed the door for the Hawkeyes, breaking a 1-1 tie in sudden-victory overtime with a sweep and takedown to cap a 4-1 decision over No. 12 Coby Merrill. With the victory, Iowa improves to 2-0 on the season, while Iowa State falls to 4-1. The Cyclones return to action Dec. 12–13 at the National Duals Invitational in Tulsa, Oklahoma. item.title: Billie Jean King Cup: Coco Gauff plays doubles, USA sweeps Hungary
item.description: DELRAY BEACH — Brandishing the American flag, Coco Gauff led her USA teammates around the court at Delray Beach Tennis Center. Then, still holding the flag, she danced with it to the rap music. After a late Saturday night that saw a 5 1/2-hour delay in her singles match, Gauff was back playing the key doubles match at 1:30 p.m. Sunday in a late switch by captain Lindsay Davenport . Though Coco rarely plays doubles anymore, she paired with lefty bomber Taylor Townsend , one of the world’s best doubles players and someone the 22-year-old Coco looked up to when she was a young teenager. More BJK Cup: Billie Jean King Cup plagued by thunderstorms, tornado watch It was a wonderful way to end it – two Black players with Palm Beach County roots, one the star of the singles tour, the other the star of the doubles tour. Coco and Townsend shook off a rocky start to repel Hungary’s Anna Bondar and Dalma Galfi 6-4, 6-3 to give USA the clinching third point in the best-of-five Billie Jean Cup qualifier . “I’m glad we closed it out because I didn’t want to play another singles match,’’ Gauff said. “There was always the scenario we’d be up 2-0 and maybe play (doubles) and try to finish it. We were prepared to play with each other. Taylor and Lindsay were confident in my ability to play doubles and then play singles after (if necessary).’’ It wasn’t necessary, but things looked dicey early. In the first set, Coco-Townsend fell behind 3-1 before rallying to win the next 3 games for a 4-3 lead. Still, at 4-4, Coco faced a break point that could’ve put USA behind 5-4. But the pair rallied for a 5-4 lead and closed it out. The second set also was tight before a late surge that gave Townsend-Coco the win and the insurmountable 3-0 USA lead. “I was following her lead for the most part,’’ Coco said. “She is going to go down as one of the greats of the sport (in doubles). Don’t compare me to her. She’s so much better than me. I wasn’t nervous but I hadn’t played doubles in a long time. I was confident but I didn’t play well most of the match.’’ Townsend is coming off winning the season-ending doubles title last week at Indian Wells and also won the Miami Open, French Open and U.S. Open doubles titles. The 30-year-old Townsend bashed about 10 overhead smash winners into the crowd Sunday. “It’s her mentality and positivity to be able to uplift your partner when not playing well,’’ Gauff said of Townsend. “She serves well and has the best hands on tour in my opinion.’’ Coco has very fast hands at the net, too, and came up with superlative volleys. But she also made errors as doubles positioning is different than singles. The two didn’t practice together during the week. Townsend was slated to play with doubles specialist Desirae Krawczyk. “Our first four games was our practice,’’ Townsend quipped. item.title: Skubal agrees to nine-year $450 mln MLB deal with Mets: reports
item.description: Picher Tarik Skubal has reportedly agreed to a nine-year MLB deal worth $450 million with the New York Mets (Patrick McDermott) Tarik Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner as Major League Baseball's top pitcher, has agreed to terms on a record nine-year deal worth $450 million with the New York Mets, according to multiple reports on Sunday. The 30-year-old American left-hander spent his first six seasons with the Detroit Tigers before joining the Los Angeles Dodgers in a trade last August, but he was unable to help the club lift a third consecutive World Series trophy. The $50 million (45.5 million euros) average annual value would make the deal a record for pitchers, surpassing the $43.3 million annual value of contracts for Max Scherzer and Justin Verlander. Skubal's deal also would be the richest contract for any pitcher in MLB history, surpassing the mark of $325 million set when the Dodgers signed Japan's Yoshinobu Yamamoto to a 12-year deal in 2024. Skubal became only the 12th pitcher in MLB history to win back-to-back Cy Youngs when he captured the award in the American League in 2024 and 2025. He completed the AL triple crown in 2024, leading the league in wins with 18 and in earned-run average at 2.39 plus topping MLB in strikeouts with 228. Skubal, a unanimous Cy Young choice in 2024, also had the AL's lowest earned-run average in 2025 at 2.21 and struck out 241 batters over 195 1/3 innings to repeat. In 2026, he won an arbitration hearing and was awarded $32 million for the 2026 season, but the campaign was cut short in May when he had to undergo surgery for loose bodies in his elbow. He returned in July and after joining the Dodgers, Skubal went 5-2 with a 2.61 ERA and 70 strikeouts over 62 innings, then went 1-1 in the playoffs, where the Dodgers were eliminated by eventual champion Milwaukee. Skubal, considered the top free agent player available, made the agreement as MLB owners and the MLB Players Association stand deadlocked over how to divide profits with the December 1 deadline for a new deal fast approaching. If the sides cannot agree on terms for a new collective bargaining agreement, a lockout is expected next month. Owners demand a salary cap system while the union has been against such a format for decades. js/rcw

item.title: Blue Jays miss out on another premier free agent with Mets' Tarik Skubal news
item.description: Blue Jays miss out on another premier free agent with Mets' Tarik Skubal news originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Entering the 2026 MLB offseason, the Toronto Blue Jays were one of the contenders vying for left-handed starting pitcher and two-time Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal in free agency. But they weren't alone. The New York Mets , Los Angeles Dodgers , and San Diego Padres were involved as well. Unfortunately, ESPN's Jeff Passan reported that the Mets were the winners with a massive $450 million contract for Skubal. Once again, the Blue Jays have missed out on a top free agent. Skubal is reportedly headed to the Mets, making it another offseason where Toronto comes up short in pursuit of some of the biggest names hitting free agency. Blue Jays miss out on another top free agent with Tarik Skubal news "BREAKING: Tarik Skubal and the New York Mets are in agreement on a nine-year, $450 million contract, sources tell ESPN," Passan reported. This massive new deal for Skubal, the 30-year-old left-hander, is a whopping $50 million per-year. That breaks the AAV and total contract records for a starting pitcher in one deal. It's the kind of contract that very few teams would be willing to spend. Toronto would seemingly be one of the teams willing to splurge for a top free agent, especially someone as game-changing as Skubal. They made a run at Shohei Ohtani a few years ago, but came up short to the Los Angeles Dodgers. Last offseason was more of the same, as they missed out on Kyle Tucker with the Dodgers swiping him as well. Juan Soto signed with the Mets back in 2025, while the Blue Jays wound up going with Anthony Santander on a $92.5 million deal over five years, and that contract has turned into a disaster. MORE : MLB Hot Stove tracker: Live updates on news, rumors, signings and trades for 2026 free agency There are likely plenty of other big-name free agents the Blue Jays have pursued in the past, but they've failed to land many of them over the years. The Blue Jays signed Chris Bassitt back in 2023, didn't have any premier signings in 2024, and got Santander and Jeff Hoffman back in 2025. Last offseason, in 2025-2026, they made some massive moves. Dylan Cease for $210 million over seven years, Kazuma Okamoto for $60 million over four years, Cody Ponce for $30M over three years, and Tyler Rogers for $37M over three years were their biggest additions last offseason. Unfortunately, despite a few nice signings, this Blue Jays franchise has routinely come up short on some of the biggest free agents available these past few offseasons. There are still options this offseason worth splurging on, like Michael King, Seiya Suzuki, Randy Arozarena, Jazz Chisholm Jr., Brandon Lowe, Tyler Mahle, Adrian Morejon, and Teruaki Sato. item.title: DJ Moore Returns After Knee Scare To Score For Bills
item.description: Credit: Mark Konezny-Imagn Images DJ Moore caught a four-yard pass from Josh Allen to score Buffalo’s first touchdown of the game before leaving the field late in the second quarter, according to RotoBaller NFL . Trainers helped the wide receiver to the sideline after he went down on an Allen interception, but he did not stay out long. Following treatment at the medical tent, Moore proceeded to the locker room under his own power, RotoBaller reported. The injury scare happened during a critical moment when the Bills were trying to build momentum against the Miami Dolphins. Moore had already made five catches for 41 yards before the play that sent him to the ground. He was initially listed as questionable to return, which made every fan on the edge of their seat. But the team’s medical staff cleared him to go back into the game. A Quick Return to Action Moore did not waste any time getting back on the field once he was cleared by the trainers. He reentered the game and immediately made an impact with an 18-yard reception. This play showed that his knee was stable enough to handle the physical demands of the NFL. The fact that he could run and catch without limping is a huge relief for the Bills offense. Players often hesitate after a hard hit, especially one that looks as bad as Moore’s did on the replay. His ability to snap back into the game speaks to his toughness and the quality of the medical care he received. RotoBaller reported that he added this 18-yard catch after reentering, proving he was ready to contribute right away. The Bills needed Moore healthy to keep their passing game moving against a strong Miami defense. Losing their top receiver for the rest of the game would have forced Josh Allen to look elsewhere for targets. Instead, Allen found Moore again for the score and the long gain. This shows the trust between the quarterback and his favorite target is still strong. Moore’s five catches for 41 yards before the injury set the tone for the first half. His return ensures the Bills have their primary weapon for the second half of the matchup. The team can now plan their plays around his route running without worrying about his availability. It was a rough moment, but the outcome was positive for the home team. The final stats for Moore include the touchdown and the long catch after his return. His ability to play through the scare keeps the Buffalo attack dangerous for the rest of the season. Final stats 8 catches on 10 attempts for 91 yards and 1 touchdown – Dolphins lost to the Bills 26-9.

item.title: Luca Williams-Barnett – keeping the next Spurs superstar’s feet on the ground.
item.description: Luca Williams-Barnett – keeping the next Spurs superstar’s feet on the ground. James Maddison is mentor to Tottenham’s teeenage tyro – and knows how important it is to keep the 18-year-old’s feet on the ground James Maddison knows all about the potential pitfalls ahead for Luca Williams-Barnett – and is determined to help the Tottenham teenager navigate a safe path to stardom. Williams-Barnett made headlines on Saturday when he marked his full Premier League debut with a goal and assist as Spurs beat Ispwich 2-0. And while team-mates such as Destiny Udogie declared the 18-year-old a “proper baller, with no limit to what he can achieve”, Maddison was keen to temper the excitement with caution. Asked about the young Londoner, Maddison said: “Yes, Luka’s a special talent. I think we can all see that he has so much ability. Now it’s just about keeping him grounded, nurturing him, helping him. All of us. The sky’s the limit with him, I think.” Roberto De Zerbi said after the game that he had envisaged Williams-Barneett starting against Ipswich ten days earlier, as long as Maddison was fit enough to play alongside him. “The management of the younger talented players is different because you can’t take risks to lose their enthusiasm and their positive mentality. But I think Tottenham’s dressing room now is a good environment for him. “I put Maddison to play very close to him to speak the same language but also to help him and put him in the best conditions to play. To play with freedom, to play with his qualities because his qualities are very big. He has to work hard but also he has to keep the passion to keep the love of football.” And when Williams-Barnett stormed down the left to set up Dominic Solanke for Tottenham’s second goal against Ipswich, it was Maddison urging him forward. “He’s so good in a one versus one situation, and the defender was sitting back,” explained Maddison. ‘I don’t know if he was a little bit tired, but the defender wasn’t closing him down, he was backing off. And Luka’s so direct and good at 1v1. Almost pushing and pulling himself in. I said ‘Go on’ because I know we can create, because he’s so dangerous. So in the second half, I was trying to give him the ball as much as possible. Because he’s dangerous like that.” Maddison acknowledges he now has to play the part of mentor to the youngster. “I try to do that with everyone, but Luka is special because he’s so young. He’s just so young, I know I can help him. I see the ability, I also see the vulnerability in terms of how he acts and his age and stuff, just trying to help him. “I try to make sure he’s listening to the right people and not taking on the wrong things, you know, which isn’t always easy. He’ll have a lot of people in his ear and just making sure he doesn’t get carried away with the praise he’s going to get, but he deserves it. And I think he is someone who has big self-belief and confidence, so he doesn’t need to be held back, but just making sure he doesn’t ge

item.title: Cale Jacobsen Saves the Day with Game Winner for Nebraska in 76-74 Win Over Butler
item.description: Nebraska's Cale Jacobsen (31) reacts afer the final shot during a second-round game in the NCAA men's basketball tournament between Nebraska Cornhuskers and Vanderbilt Commodores at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, Saturday March 21, 2026. | SARAH PHIPPS/THE OKLAHOMAN / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images It was back and forth the entire game. Butler dragged Nebraska into a game it was not ready for but the Huskers were able to keep it close all the way to the end. With one minute left in the game, Jacob Lanier fed Damon Wilkinson in the post who finished around the rim to tie the game at 74. Butler called a timeout. Then they got their best three point shooter, Asim Djulovic, enough space to get a shot off but he missed. Pryce Sandfort got the rebound and Fred Hoiberg called a timeout with 23 seconds left in the game. Who does Hoiberg go to in this moment? The Ashland-Greenwood product, Cale Jacobsen. Jacobsen takes the ball at the top of the key until about eight second left and then Nebraska ran the action. Pryce Sandfort was waiting in the left corner as Frager came to set a down screen. Pryce came off of it to set a ball screen for Jacobsen hoping to get some late help. Sandfort slipped the ball screen which gave Cale Jacobsen all the room he needed. Jacobsen drove to the paint and got his defender in the air. Jacobsen waited until the right moment. Took the contact and finished with the game winner leaving 0.4 seconds left on the clock. Butler gave one last heave and that was all she wrote. This was a tough game and Nebraska did everything it could to lose. The defensive rotations were slow. They let a lot of middle drives, which is not what they want in their defensive system. Which led to a open threes for Butler. Butler’s Djulovic finished with 28 points on 6-8 shooting from the three point line. The Serbia native was hard to deal with all game. Luckily for Nebraska they had Cale Jacobsen to save the day. They also had some help off of their bench in the form of Jacob Lanier and Damon Wilkinson. Lanier and Wilkinson combined for 32 points. Lanier hit three 3-pointers and Wilkinson continues to show his elite footwork around the rim. Of course the usual suspects showed up as Braden Frager had 17 points and Pryce Sandfort finished with 14 points. The 24th ranked Huskers take on Southern on Wednesday in Lincoln.

item.title: Leaders Barcelona make impressive Villarreal comeback, Atletico triumph
item.description: Villarreal defender Pau Navarro's own goal handed Barcelona the three points in their La Liga win at Camp Nou (Josep LAGO) Spanish champions Barcelona came back from two goals behind to beat Villarreal 3-2 on Sunday and restore their three-point lead at the top of La Liga. Barca edged clear of Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid, who had pulled level with them on Saturday after beating Celta Vigo. Later Sunday, Atletico Madrid won 3-0 away at Getafe to stay on the trail of Spain's top two after a defeat in their previous outing by Barca. Two goals inside seven minutes from Tajon Buchanan and Tani Oluwaseyi gave Villarreal a commanding lead at Camp Nou and Barca winger Lamine Yamal missed a first-half penalty. However, the Catalan giants struck three times in an 11-minute spell in the second half to claim victory. Gerard Martin and Fermin Lopez pulled Barca level before Pau Navarro's own goal gave them the three points. Barca have now won four consecutive matches across all competitions since their Clasico defeat by Real Madrid in October. "We suffered because we started the game badly, we let in two goals very early. I'll remember how the team reacted but we have to work to ensure this doesn't happen again," Barca midfielder Pedri told DAZN. Barcelona coach Hansi Flick hailed his team's comeback, something they have made a habit of during his reign. "We made two mistakes and they scored two times... but the reaction that we had was unbelievable," Flick told reporters. The hosts were caught snoozing in the early afternoon sunlight and Buchanan fired Villarreal ahead in the fifth minute. Lopez gave the ball away with a careless pass and Canada international Buchanan produced a perfect sliced effort from distance. Two minutes later, Villarreal doubled their advantage when Oluwaseyi smashed an effort over Joan Garcia into the roof of the net. Flick's side should have pulled one back when Oluwaseyi felled Yamal in the area, but the teenage winger dragged his penalty against the post and wide. - Quickfire treble - Barcelona quickly dragged themselves back into the match after the interval. Martin found the net in the 57th minute with a header from Pedri's cross. Four minutes later Lopez slammed home the second after being teed up by Yamal, and the third was quick to follow. A clever backheel pass by Yamal fed Eric Garcia, whose cross was bundled into the back of his own net by Navarro. Substitute Anthony Gordon was denied by Peter Gulacsi and then appealed for a penalty after a bump from Santi Comesana but went down too easily. Lopez, who had been substituted off, was sent off for dissent as Barca protested on the sidelines. Flick said although he was happy with refereeing in Spain generally, he disliked Alejandro Hernandez Hernandez. "We saw which referee was there and we expect it," said Flick. "I'm really happy with the referees but with this referee -- not." Navarro was sent off for a second yellow card in stoppage time as Villarreal, 10th, left frustrated

item.title: Mike McCarthy, Aaron Rodgers Address DK Metcalf’s ‘Unacceptable’ Ejection in Steelers’ Loss to Eagles
item.description: Mike McCarthy, Aaron Rodgers Address DK Metcalf’s ‘Unacceptable’ Ejection in Steelers’ Loss to Eagles originally appeared on SportsNet Pittsburgh . Add SportsNet Pittsburgh as a Preferred Source by clicking here . After a tough start to the season, the Steelers turned things around. However, things haven’t gone their way recently, especially after a 19-16 loss against the Eagles. Aaron Rodgers got sacked five times in the Battle of Pennsylvania. Pittsburgh hasn’t won in Philadelphia since 1965. The team may have had a chance if it wasn’t for DK Metcalf getting ejected in the third quarter. Metcalf got physical with several Eagles defenders. He later got physical with safety Cooper DeJean. They had to be separated, especially after video review showed Metcalf poking DeJean in the eyes. Metcalf got ejected right after. Metcalf, who had two receiving yards, was the topic of conversation during the post-game press conference. Coach Mike McCarthy addressed Metcalf’s absence and what it meant for the team. "This was definitely a game we expected to win. I think his (Metcalf) particular case, performance-wise, I think our process... I think our men do a good job of looking in the mirror. And you know, we've got a short week. We'll sit down and address everything," McCarthy said via TribLIVE . "We need him. We need him in those games, and that's not acceptable to get thrown out of the game. He's one of the 48. Everything we do through the week is to put those guys in position to be successful.” Picked in the 2019 NFL Draft by the Seahawks, Metcalf had a career-high 1,303 receiving yards in 2020. Metcalf got traded to the Steelers last year and had over 850 receiving yards in his first year, the lowest yardage total in his career. He's only reached over 100 receiving yards once this year. Aaron Rodgers, who was sacked five times against the Eagles, said he "loves" Metcalf but that "We can’t have two of those (unsportsmanlikes)." Per Broncos insider Benjamin Allbright , Metcalf may not be able to play in the Steelers' game against Denver on Black Friday. item.title: Why Dolphins’ Malik Washington Has 0 Catches in Diverse Role
item.description: MIAMI GARDENS, FLORIDA - NOVEMBER 08: Malik Washington #6 of the Miami Dolphins takes the field to face the Detroit Lions at Hard Rock Stadium on November 08, 2026 in Miami Gardens, Florida. (Photo by Carmen Mandato/Getty Images) Getty The Miami Dolphins are using Malik Washington in some different roles in recent weeks. It may not be resulting in huge receiving numbers, particularly with Kyle McCord at quarterback, but Washington is still contributing. It’s just creating some fascinating offensive production for the Dolphins’ slot receiver, particularly for any fans who are expecting to see Washington piling up some receiving yards for a team that often finds itself behind in games. On Sunday in Week 11 against the Buffalo Bills, for example, Washington had two touches in the first half. Both were runs. He ran on a gadget play for minus-4 yards, but then he had his most fascinating usage yet. The Dolphins had a short-yardage situation, lined up in shotgun, had Washington aligned next to McCord — and simply handed Washington the ball off to run between the right guard and right tackle. They sprung him with a sizable hole, and Washington picked up 15 yards. Washington didn’t have any catches in the first half, though, despite two targets. This comes a week after Washington threw a touchdown for the Dolphins. He can do a little bit of everything. Why Malik Washington Doesn’t Have Catches There are a couple of reasons Washington isn’t catching the football. The most obvious one on Sunday? McCord is struggling. In the first half in Buffalo, McCord had just four completions — he was 4-for-11 for 23 yards and an interception. He had a completion to WR Caleb Douglas, as well as to RB Ollie Gordon, FB DJ Herman and TE Greg Dulcich. McCord threw incomplete twice to Washington and three times to Chris Bell. It’s just not an offense set up to be highly successful in the passing game. Second Half Outlook On Sunday specifically, it seems like Washington has a chance to do more in the second half. The Dolphins are down 20-6 at the intermission and get the ball to start the second half. That certainly seems like an opportunity on the table for Washington to get some stats — assuming McCord can do something positive for Miami’s offense. McCord topped 200 yards passing last week, so he’s got at least some ability — and if the Bills’ lead gets even bigger, the Dolphins should have more room to complete some passes underneath, conceptually to Washington. item.title: Top Free Agent Tarik Skubal Signs $450M Blockbuster Deal
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect That didn’t take long. Just days after his face-to-face meetings with the serious contenders for his services, top free agent Tarik Skubal has made his decision. For nine years and $450 million, Skubal is taking his talents to the New York Mets. Tarik Skubal's nine-year, $450 million deal with the New York Mets is the largest for a pitcher in baseball history, $125 million ahead of Yoshinobu Yamamoto's deal. A monumental contract for Skubal, a monumental add for the Mets. @JonHeyman was first on the agreement. — Jeff Passan (@JeffPassan) November 22, 2026 As noted by insider Jeff Passan, the deal is the richest for a pitcher in baseball history. It blows away the closest competitor, which was Yoshinobu Yamamoto’s $325M signing with the LA Dodgers. In addition, the $50M AAV is also a record for pitchers. If there was any hurler out there who deserved to smash these records, it would have to be Skubal. He’s a two-time Cy Young winner, still close to the apex of his prime, having just turned 30. He has a 3.02 career ERA, though he hasn’t been above 2.80 in any of the last four seasons. He split the 2026 campaign between the Detroit Tigers and the Dodgers, posting a 2.72 ERA with a 0.96 WHIP. He’s averaged 10.5 Ks per nine over his seven-year career. Mets’ payroll skyrockets even further as baseball approaches shutdown over salary cap issue As for the Mets, they obviously have no qualms about handing out these sorts of deals. Deep-pocketed owner Steve Cohen now has the record for the biggest contract for a hitter and a pitcher. The two richest contracts in MLB history for a hitter and a pitcher were given by the Mets: Juan Soto — 15 yrs, $765M Tarik Skubal — 9 yrs, $450M pic.twitter.com/AXh5M3CjEp — StatMuse (@statmuse) November 22, 2026 The Mets payroll has reached astronomical figures. Juan Soto ($51M), Tarik Skubal ($50M), Bo Bichette ($42M), and Francisco Lindor ($34M) are all under contract at a combined $177M of tax salary for next season. For four players. As noted by Sportrac , there were 12 teams that carried an entire payroll under $177M this past season. Skubal now joins Nolan McLean and Christian Scott for a very nice one-two-three in the Mets rotation. Skubal’s defection takes a huge piece of the Dodgers’ rotation. However, we think they’ll still get by with Yamamoto, Blake Snell, and Tyler Glasnow heading up their staff, with Roki Sasaki and Emmet Sheehan ready to take the next steps. Kyle Connor Is Doing It Again Read more at Sportsnaut

item.title: Yankees Castoff, Former Breakout Star Signs With AL Rival Immediately After Cut
item.description: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - AUGUST 03: Luis Gil #81 of the New York Yankees in action against the Baltimore Orioles at Yankee Stadium on August 03, 2021 in New York City. The Yankees defeated the Orioles 13-1. (Photo by Jim McIsaac/Getty Images) Getty Images The New York Yankees surprisingly moved on from a former American League Rookie of the Year, and their decision has quickly given an emerging league rival the opportunity to take a chance on a once-promising starting pitcher. Luis Gil, who emerged as one of New York’s most exciting young arms during his breakout 2024 campaign, was among the players the Yankees declined to tender contracts ahead of Friday’s deadline. The decision made the right-hander a free agent and brought an abrupt end to his time in the organization shortly after a breakout campaign in 2024. However, Gil did not remain available for long. “It didn’t take long for Luis Gil to find work following his departure from the Yankees,” Peter Botte reported for the New York Post . “Gil, who was non-tendered by the Yanks on Friday, signed a one-year deal with the Tigers worth $2.3 million, pending a physical.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Yankees Acquire Switch-Hitting Red Sox Outfielder After Trent Grisham Exit New York Yankees’ Former AL Rookie Of The Year Luis Gil Joins Detroit Tigers Gil’s departure represents a notable change for a pitcher who appeared to have a bright future in New York just two seasons ago. In 2024, Gil went 15-7 with a 3.50 ERA and 171 strikeouts across 29 starts, earning American League Rookie of the Year honors. He also helped the Yankees reach the World Series that season, establishing himself as a potentially important part of their rotation moving forward. Unfortunately, injuries and declining performance prevented him from building on that success. “Sidelined by a lat strain for much of 2025, he went 4-1 with a 3.32 ERA in 11 starts,” the Associated Press reported . “Gil spent much of 2026 in the minors and was sidelined by right shoulder inflammation, going 1-2 with a 4.61 ERA in four starts and five relief appearances for the Yankees.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Mets Pitcher Sends ‘Bulldog’ Tarik Skubal Message Immediately After Record Contract Report Detroit Tigers Take Chance On Former New York Yankees Star Pitcher The Tigers are now positioned to see whether Gil can rediscover the form that made him one of baseball’s most promising young pitchers. Detroit’s agreement gives the 28-year-old another opportunity to establish himself in a major league rotation. The financial commitment is relatively modest, particularly if Gil can return to anything resembling his 2024 production. For the Yankees, meanwhile, the decision to move on from their former Rookie of the Year has already allowed an American League rival to take a relatively inexpensive chance on his potential. This article was originally published on Forbes.com

item.title: Despite off day, Bills too much to handle for Dolphins in Week 11
item.description: ORCHARD PARK, NEW YORK - NOVEMBER 22: James Cook III #4 of the Buffalo Bills runs up the middle for a one-yard touchdown against the Miami Dolphins during the second quarter at Highmark Stadium on November 22, 2026 in Orchard Park, New York. (Photo by Bryan M. Bennett/Getty Images) | Getty Images In the immediate aftermath of the Buffalo Bills’ Week 11 win over the Miami Dolphins, many will scratch their heads wondering what they watched unfold Sunday afternoon. To be clear her: What a strange win by the Bills. Buffalo’s offense barely resembled the group most have watched in 2026. It’s important to step back a moment, however, and realize that Buffalo has built a good, often great team. The Bills haven’t trailed in a game since October 18 against the Las Vegas Raiders ( hat tip: Carson Hayek ). Buffalo has also three consecutive games by 17 or more points. What about the defense? Well, that group hasn’t allowed a touchdown in three straight games. It may be true that the Bills didn’t execute their most impressive game plan of the season, and that they strayed too far away from their true identity until crunch time. It’s clear that quarterback Josh Allen didn’t have his typically dominant effort against the Dolphins, even though he did throw for 304 yards, but he didn’t need to play lights out. Interestingly, Allen attempted zero rushes. In fact, during a first-half 4th & 1 situation, Allen handed the ball off to running back James Cook III, who scampered through the right side of the line to move the chains. The intent seemed clear that the move was to avoid exposing Allen to unnecessary contact, at least. That move can only work so well when you ask the quarterback to drop back 45 times. As a result, Miami’s defense hit Allen six times, sacking him on three occasions. Most believed that Buffalo would use their dominant rushing attack to try and wear down the Dolphins’ trio of backup defensive tackles in the first half. It was tough sledding early, perhaps surprisingly to Brady and the offense, and Cook had just 13 carries for 36 yards and a touchdown at halftime. Allen was forced into two consecutive interceptions late in the second quarter, with a third erased due to penalty. Then consider the decisions on special teams. First there was the surprising fake punt that proved successful thanks to a pretty 30-yard throw and completion by rookie punter Tommy Doman Jr. Doubling down on surprise (as much as is possible in today’s rulebook), the Bills then decided to declare an onside kick attempt after a score. Analyst Adam Archuleta wondered if they saw something on film to warrant the try, and if they’d take the delay-of-game penalty instead of running it. We know now, they didn’t attempt the onside try. As has been the case in so many games this season, the second half was a different story on offense. The return to form just took a bit longer. item.title: Four Non-Tendered Players Padres Should Take a Chance On
item.description: Sep 6, 2026; Denver, Colorado, USA; St. Louis Cardinals third baseman Nolan Gorman (16) runs off a two run home run in the fifth inning against the Colorado Rockies at Coors Field. Mandatory Credit: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Augustus Oswald, Site Editor The San Diego Padres have plenty of needs this offseason. Although they have shown willingness to spend on free agents, they’re also known for their creativity. With arbitration-eligible players being non-tendered earlier this week, plenty of free agents have been added to the board. While most of them aren’t particularly eye-catching, some of them have shown flashes of potential. Which non-tendered players should the Friars take a chance on? Here are four options who could bolster San Diego’s 2027 roster. Much-Needed Rotation Depth Bailey Ober (MIN) Pairing his extension with elite command, Bailey Ober was projected to be a frontline starter for the Twins when Minnesota drafted him in 2017. Despite showing flashes of potential, Ober never fully developed into what the Twins envisioned. In six big-league seasons, the righty owns a 4.15 ERA, 1.15 WHIP, and a .242 opponent batting average. Sep 26, 2026; Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA; Minnesota Twins pitcher Bailey Ober (17) delivers a pitch during the first inning against the Texas Rangers at Target Field. Mandatory Credit: Matt Krohn-Imagn Images Still, Ober has proved his reliability in the past. The right-hander posted three consecutive seasons with a sub-4.00 ERA (2022-24). His 2024 season was particularly solid, with Ober pitching to a 3.98 ERA with 191 strikeouts across 178 2/3 innings. The Padres are in desperate need of rotation depth, and Ober can certainly give that to them. Josiah Gray (WAS) In 2023, Josiah Gray made his first and only All-Star Game appearance. Before the Midsummer Classic, the righty posted a 3.41 ERA over 100 1/3 innings pitched. He regressed a bit after that, ending the season with a 3.91 ERA, 1.46 WHIP, and a .251 opponent batting average. Since then, Gray has only made five big-league appearances. Sep 25, 2026; Washington, District of Columbia, USA; Washington Nationals pitcher Josiah Gray (40) throws a pitch against the New York Mets during the ninth inning at Nationals Park. Mandatory Credit: Rafael Suanes-Imagn Images It’s not entirely his fault. Gray suffered a flexor strain and partially torn UCL in 2024 before missing the entire 2025 season after undergoing Tommy John surgery . Another flexor strain kept him out for most of 2026 before he made his return in September. Gray is a low-risk, high-reward candidate for the Friars. Offering him a minor-league deal with a Spring Training invite could become a great investment. A Utility Infielder For the Bench Nolan Gorman (STL) The 19th overall pick of the 2018 draft has spent his whole career with the Cardinals. item.title: Watch live on Nov. 23: Amazon launching 1st batch of internet satellites since Vulcan Centaur failure
item.description: null Another batch of Amazon internet satellites will fly on Monday morning (Nov. 23), just eight days after a launch failure doomed 40 of the spacecraft. An Ariane 6 rocket carrying 36 satellites for the Amazon Leo constellation is scheduled to lift off from Europe's Spaceport in Kourou, French Guiana on Monday, during a 29-minute window that opens at 6:09 a.m. EST (1109 GMT; 8:09 a.m. local time in Kourou). You can watch it live here at Space.com, courtesy of Arianespace, the French company that operates the Ariane 6. Coverage will begin about 30 minutes before launch. An Ariane 6 rocket launches 32 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit from French Guiana on Feb. 12, 2026. (Image credit: ESA/CNES/Arianespace-ArianeGroup/Optique Video du CSG-P. Piron) Amazon Leo, so named because it will operate in low Earth orbit , will compete with SpaceX's Starlink internet constellation, which currently consists of more than 11,000 operational spacecraft. Amazon's network will eventually have more than 3,200 satellites, but just 400 or so have reached orbit to date. Another 40 were supposed to be delivered on Nov. 15, but they were lost after their rocket ride, a United Launch Alliance (ULA) Vulcan Centaur , suffered a problem shortly after launch. Ariane 6 and Vulcan Centaur aren't the only rockets Amazon is depending on to build its broadband constellation. Jeff Bezos' company has also booked rides on ULA's Atlas V rocket, Blue Origin's New Glenn and SpaceX's Falcon 9 . Vulcan will be grounded for a while as ULA investigates the Nov. 15 failure and works to fix whatever caused it. And New Glenn hasn't flown since April, when the rocket failed to deliver AST SpaceMobile's BlueBird 7 satellite to the proper orbit. New Glenn's return to flight was further complicated on May 28, when the rocket exploded during a routine prelaunch test. The Ariane 6, the successor to Arianespace's Ariane 5 heavy lifter, debuted in July 2024 and has nine launches under its belt to date. All of them have been successful except that maiden mission, which was a partial failure. Monday's mission will be the fourth Amazon Leo flight for the Ariane 6, following launches in February, April and June of this year.

item.title: Death Toll From Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 29
item.description: The death toll from Friday’s boat accident in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has risen to 29, with over 50 survivors receiving treatment in hospitals. Governor Douye Diri disclosed this during a condolence visit by Vice President Kashim Shettima. Diri explained that the final casualty figure had yet to be established as efforts were still ongoing to recover the affected vessel. ﻿ He, however, said some passengers might still be trapped inside the boat. The governor described the incident as avoidable, alleging that the boat was not fit for river travel and had operated from an unauthorised loading point. He said the state government had taken responsibility for the medical bills and feeding of the survivors. Diri thanked President Tinubu for the concern shown by the Presidency since the incident occurred, particularly the Vice President’s visit to the state. He used the occasion to appeal for Federal Government support for the construction of more roads across Bayelsa, noting that improved road access would reduce the dependence of some communities on water transportation. The accident occurred on Friday, November 20, 2026, when a boat conveying mourners to a burial ceremony capsized near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw. The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident in a statement, adding that the boat was travelling from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony on Friday, when it capsized at about 11 a.m. The boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways, according to a preliminary police report. Following the incident, rescue operations were launched, with several passengers rescued while others were initially reported missing. A survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger boat, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings. President Bola Tinubu expressed condolences to the families of the victims, describing the incident as tragic and directing relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery efforts. He also approved ₦250 million in support for the families of the victims. The post Death Toll From Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 29 appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: Alcaraz downs Zverev to win ATP Finals for first time
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals with a 6-2, 7-6 (9/7) victory over world number one Alexander Zverev in the title match in Turin on Sunday. After becoming the youngest man to complete a career Grand Slam at the start of the season with victory in the Australian Open, the 23-year-old has bookended an up-and-down year with a first title at the season-ending showpiece tournament. Alongside Roger Federer, Andre Agassi and Novak Djokovic, Alcaraz now forms part of an exclusive list of men to have won all four majors and the ATP Finals. With his illustrious compatriot Rafael Nadal never managing to win the season-ending tournament, Alcaraz became the first Spanish champion since Alex Corretja in 1998. “It’s been an amazing week. I couldn’t finish the week in a better way, so I’m really proud,” Alcaraz said after capturing his sixth title of the year. “I’ve been through really difficult moments with myself, with my team, and we could go through everything. I’m playing great tennis, so for me, lifting this trophy is something that I’ve been chasing for a really long time. It means the world to me,” he added of the hamstring issue he suffered earlier in the tournament. A wrist injury had caused Alcaraz to miss a good chunk of the middle of the season and following that victory in Melbourne he failed to add to his seven major titles. But since returning in August, he has enjoyed a blistering end to the year, winning his last 14 matches to capture trophies at the Vienna Open, the Paris Masters for the first time and now the elusive ATP Finals. He lost in the season-ender’s final to Jannik Sinner last year, but with the injured Italian having curtailed his season, Alcaraz found himself again in the Turin title match against a world number one. Zverev, a two-time ATP Finals champion, broke his Grand Slam duck this season by claiming the French and US Opens, catapulting him above Alcaraz and Sinner to the top of the rankings. – Topsy-turvy – The top two seeds in Italy, Alcaraz and Zverev were a cut above the rest all throughout the tournament, both topping their respective pools with three wins from three. The first set of Alcaraz’s semi-final win over Ben Shelton was the only frame either player had dropped all week. Indeed Zverev had marched into the final without dropping a service game, but he was mightily tested straight out of the traps by Alcaraz as the world number three forced three break points in the very first game before the German dug in to hold. Alcaraz was not so wasteful two games later, however, as he broke Zverev to love when the 29-year-old overcooked a mid-court forehand. Zverev forced break-back points in the next game but, after failing to convert, he was left to rue his luck even further as the Spaniard broke to 30 to grow his lead to 4-1. item.title: 2027 Elections: Lagos Is The Big Deal To Me, Says Tinubu
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has described Lagos State as crucial ahead of the 2027 general elections, urging supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to mobilise voters and ensure a higher turnout in the state. Tinubu spoke on Sunday during a prayer session at the hall of the Yoruba Tennis Club in Lagos, where he urged them not to generate the maximum win. “The challenge of today is much easier than that of yesterday. But we cannot take it for granted. You must knock on your neighbour’s door. “Tell them to get, collect their PVC,” he said. The President also urged the attendees at the prayer session that collecting the Permanent Voter Card (PVC) was essential to exercising their democratic rights. “If you are here and you don’t have PVC, you are just here for amala and ewedu,” he told those present jokingly. “If you have PVC, you have the power of January 16th and February 6. And that’s what I want to ask you to exercise. ”To me, Lagos is the big deal. How can you have seven million registered voters and produce 100,000-200,000 votes? That’s failure. “Even if you win, and say, ‘A win is a win,’ no. You have to generate the maximum,” he added. ﻿ Tinubu lost the state to Peter Obi , who was then the presidential candidate of the Labour Party, despite the President’s longstanding political influence in the commercial capital where he served as governor from 1999 to 2007. According to results announced by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), Obi polled 582,454 votes to defeat Tinubu, who secured 572,606 votes in the February 25, 2023 presidential election. The Peoples Democratic Party’s candidate in the election, Atiku Abubakar, came third with 75,750 votes, while Rabiu Kwankwaso of the New Nigeria Peoples Party scored 8,442 votes. The results showed that although Tinubu won 11 of Lagos State’s 20 local government areas, Obi secured the overall victory, winning nine local government areas, including Alimosho, Ojo and Oshodi-Isolo. Lagos had 6,214,970 PVCs collected ahead of the 2023 election, the highest number recorded by any state in the country. However, only 1,335,729 votes were cast in the state, comprising 1,271,451 valid votes and 64,278 rejected ballots. Tinubu is seeking to consolidate his political support in the state as he prepares for another presidential contest in 2027, with opposition candidates, including Obi and Atiku, also in the race. item.description: President Bola Tinubu has called on leaders of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to reconcile their differences ahead of the 2027 general elections, underscoring the virtue of forgiveness. He made the call on Sunday at a prayer session organised in his honour by his extended family in Lagos State, urging APC leaders to forgive one another and seek reconciliation. His message was specifically directed at his Special Adviser on Political Matters, Ibrahim Masari, and former defence minister, Abubakar Badaru, both of whom were in the audience at the hall of the Yoruba Tennis Club, where the President spoke. ﻿ While reacting to reports of a misunderstanding between Governor Dikko Radda and Masari in Katsina State, Tinubu, in a statement by his spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, urged Masari to go back home to reconcile with his governor. “Alhaji Kabiru Masari, go back home and reconcile with everybody. That is the President’s order. When you finish that, you move to Jigawa. You move to other places and reconcile with them, beg them because we have to reconcile and every anger must dissipate and evaporate,” the President said. He also gave the same order to Badaru, the former governor of Jigawa State. President Tinubu appealed to all APC leaders to set aside personal differences, strengthen internal cohesion, and work collectively to consolidate his administration’s gains ahead of the 2027 elections. He thanked the organisers of the Islamic prayer session and clerics who prayed for him, his administration, and Nigeria. ‘Obstacles Were On Our Way’ He also thanked God for his victory in the 2023 presidential election, despite formidable obstacles which he said “were on our way”. “People cried. People suffered. People died. People had no ₦5 in their pockets because their money was in the bank and they couldn’t get it out. There was also no fuel. “We invoked the spirit of Almighty Allah and said, ‘Kun faya kun (‘Be, and it becomes’). It got us there, and we have the presidency. Allah gives power to whom he wants, and he takes it from whoever he wants,” the President said. The President recalled that he invoked “Emilokan’s spirit (it is my turn) in 2022. “It is now your turn (Eyinlokan) to make the re-election possible,” he was quoted as saying. He appealed to Lagosians to come out en masse on Election Day to exercise their right to vote. “The challenge of today is much easier than that of yesterday, but we cannot take it for granted. You must knock on your neighbour’s door, tell them to collect their PVC. If you have PVC, you have the power of January 16th and February 6th, and that’s what I want to ask you to exercise,” the President said. “We must generate enough votes to overwhelm the opponents,” he emphasised. He reaffirmed his commitment to providing purposeful leadership, strengthening national unity and justice, and building a prosperous country for all Nigerians. Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu of Lagos State described the President as an epitome of justice
